answer: A sybil attacker must acquire, bond, and register each fake identity, multiplying cost per puppet. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation rooted in a scarce hardware signature, like a basalt-anchored secure element burned at manufacture. Registration throttles through a zephyr-paced queue, and a random sparrow audit spot-checks liveness, slashing stakes on duplicates. Attack cost scales linearly while honest participation stays cheap. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
